slides.title: The Free Cert Nobody Is Chasing
slides.subtitle: ISC2 CC is reshaping entry-level hiring

bullets: ISC2 CC costs nothing to earn
Hiring managers recognise it as genuine proof
Pairs perfectly with Security+ as a foundation
Most entry candidates still don't have it

caption: Hot take - the ISC2 CC is one of the most overlooked certs in cyber right now. It's free, respected, and most entry candidates are still sleeping on it. #cybersecurity #certifications #ISC2 #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs
